judgment.notes: N001 is instantiated at m=1 and the interval under the distance-preserving real/one-coordinate identification. F001 supplies zero measure at every a>1; F003 supplies infinite measure at every 0<s<1, meeting its positive-exponent conditions. Endpoint, Lebesgue-measure, series and power facts have the conditions recorded in BG001–BG007. No E or M application occurs.

S001 gives arbitrarily small costs at each fixed scale, so the infimum is zero before taking the scale supremum. S002 uses measurable open supersets, requiring no measurability of cover members, and removes epsilon only when the diameter sum is finite. S003 treats zero diameters separately, uses a positive finite multiplier on nonnegative extended sums, and obtains an unbounded scale lower bound. S004 derives both dimension inequalities, including exclusion of infinite dimension. These establish every output clause.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
